milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task. Gravel floor is in the room at Z=3-7, separated from spawn by a wall with door at Z=2. Target is center of gravel floor at (0,-1,5). Distance from spawn (0,0,0) to target is √(0+1+25)≈5.1 which exceeds max_distance=5, so this does NOT auto-satisfy. Agent must walk forward through the door and look toward the gravel.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task. A sandstone pillar exists at eye level at (5,0-2,5) in the right branch room. Targeting (5,1,5) at Y=1 makes the facing check natural — agent can look straight ahead at the pillar rather than needing to look down at the floor.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task. Cobblestone slabs are placed at (-5,0,7) and (-5,0,8) in the left branch room. Target at Y=0 is close enough to eye level that a 60° facing tolerance works during normal forward-looking navigation through the room.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task. Blue terracotta forms the walls of the chamber at X=4-8, Z=11-16. Target at (6,1,13) is the center of the chamber walls at eye level. Agent must navigate deeper into the right branch past the sandstone room through doorways at Z=10 and Z=11.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task. Mossy stone brick stairs are placed at (-10,0,9) via /setblock in the left branch stairs room. Agent must navigate through the cobblestone slab room and through doorways at X=-7 and X=-8 to reach this area.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task. Diamond block is at (10,0,14) placed via /setblock in the vault room. Agent must navigate through the blue terracotta chamber and enter the vault through doorway at X=9,Z=13. Max_distance=6 ensures the agent has entered the small vault room.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task. Acacia button is wall-mounted at (11,1,16) on the south wall facing north — a small block requiring close proximity and precise facing to identify. Max_distance=5 and facing_tolerance=45° ensure the agent is close and looking directly at the far wall of the vault.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task. Light gray banner is at (-6,1,15) in the banner hall (same Y-level as other rooms, floor at Y=-1, banner at eye level Y=1). Agent must navigate through the stairs room and through doorway at (-10,Z=12) to reach this room.
